description: This file contains server-side logic for fetching and filtering booking data in a TRPC-based API, including database queries, permission checks, data enrichment, and pagination.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Main handler function for fetching bookings with pagination, filtering, and enrichment.

methods.name: getBookings
methods.description: Performs complex database queries to retrieve bookings based on filters, permissions, and sorting.

methods.name: enrichAttendeesWithUserData
methods.description: Enriches booking attendees with user profile data via a left join on email addresses.

methods.name: getEventTypeIdsFromTeamIdsFilter
methods.description: Fetches event type IDs associated with specific team IDs using optimized raw SQL.

methods.name: getAttendeeEmailsFromUserIdsFilter
methods.description: Retrieves attendee emails for given user IDs, with error handling if users do not exist.

methods.name: getEventTypeIdsFromEventTypeIdsFilter
methods.description: Fetches event type IDs for given event type IDs, including parent event types.

methods.name: getUserIdsFromTeamIds
methods.description: Fetches user IDs of members belonging to specified team IDs for permission validation.

methods.name: addStatusesQueryFilters
methods.description: Adds status-based filters to booking queries based on specified statuses.

methods.name: addAdvancedAttendeeWhereClause
methods.description: Adds advanced filtering conditions for attendee name or email with various operators.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Determines sorting order for bookings based on status and optional sort parameters.
